_readme: Shot prompts for generated demo footage (pipeline/generate.mjs). Every prompt must frame the body without a recognizable face — head cropped above the shoulders, turned away, or out of frame — because the faceless rule applies to generated footage exactly as it does to stock. Generation produces candidates only; full-motion editorial review is still the only way into assets/demo-library.json.
style: Vertical 9:16 video, one woman training at home in ordinary clothes, warm natural window light, plain modern apartment, realistic documentary footage, no gym equipment, no text, no logos, calm steady camera.
framing: Framed from the shoulders down or from behind so no face is visible at any point. Head cropped out of frame. No mirrors, no reflections showing a face.

Wall Push-Up.prompt: A woman doing wall push-ups facing a plain wall, seen from the side, framed from the shoulders down, hands flat on the wall at chest height, elbows bending
Wall Push-Up.motion: She lowers her chest toward the wall and presses back out, one slow controlled repetition, camera holds still

Incline Push-Up.prompt: A woman doing incline push-ups with both hands on the edge of a sturdy sofa, side view, framed from the shoulders down, body in a straight line
Incline Push-Up.motion: She lowers her chest toward the sofa edge and presses back up, one controlled repetition, camera holds still

Kneeling Push-Up.prompt: A woman doing push-ups from her knees on an exercise mat, side view from floor level, framed from the shoulders down, hips in line with her spine
Kneeling Push-Up.motion: She lowers her chest toward the mat and presses back up, one slow repetition, camera stays low and still

Air Squat.prompt: A woman doing bodyweight squats on a wooden floor, side view, framed from the shoulders down, arms reaching forward for balance, heels flat
Air Squat.motion: She sits her hips back and down, then stands tall again, one smooth repetition, camera holds still

Wall Sit.prompt: A woman holding a wall sit against a plain wall, side view, framed from the shoulders down, knees bent to ninety degrees, back flat against the wall
Wall Sit.motion: She holds the position, small steady breathing movement, camera holds still

Sit-to-Stand.prompt: A woman standing up from a dining chair without using her hands, side view, framed from the shoulders down, arms crossed at her chest
Sit-to-Stand.motion: She rises from the chair to standing and lowers back down under control, camera holds still

Reverse Lunge.prompt: A woman doing reverse lunges on a wooden floor, side view, framed from the shoulders down, one leg stepping back into a bent-knee lunge
Reverse Lunge.motion: She steps one foot back, lowers her back knee toward the floor, and drives back to standing, camera holds still

Split Squat.prompt: A woman in a split stance doing split squats, side view, framed from the shoulders down, front foot flat, back heel lifted
Split Squat.motion: She lowers straight down until her back knee nears the floor and presses back up, camera holds still

Glute Bridge.prompt: A woman doing glute bridges lying on an exercise mat, side view from floor level, framed from the shoulders down, knees bent, feet flat on the mat
Glute Bridge.motion: She drives her hips up until her body forms a straight line and lowers back down, one slow repetition, camera stays low and still

Hip Thrust.prompt: A woman doing hip thrusts with her upper back resting on a sofa edge, side view, framed from the shoulders down, feet flat on the floor
Hip Thrust.motion: She drives her hips up to level and lowers under control, one repetition, camera holds still

Standing Hip Hinge.prompt: A woman practising a standing hip hinge, side view, framed from the shoulders down, hands sliding down the front of her thighs, flat back
Standing Hip Hinge.motion: She pushes her hips back with a flat back and returns to standing, one slow repetition, camera holds still

Full Plank.prompt: A woman holding a forearm plank on an exercise mat, side view from floor level, framed from the shoulders down, body in one straight line
Full Plank.motion: She holds the plank, small steady breathing movement, camera stays low and still

Knee Plank.prompt: A woman holding a forearm plank from her knees on an exercise mat, side view from floor level, framed from the shoulders down
Knee Plank.motion: She holds the position steadily, small breathing movement, camera stays low and still

Side Plank.prompt: A woman holding a side plank on one forearm on an exercise mat, framed from the shoulders down, hips lifted and stacked
Side Plank.motion: She holds the side plank steadily, small breathing movement, camera holds still

Doorframe Row.prompt: A woman doing doorframe rows, both hands gripping the sides of an open doorframe, leaning back with straight arms, seen from behind and to the side, framed from the shoulders down
Doorframe Row.motion: She pulls her chest toward the doorframe and lowers back out under control, one repetition, camera holds still

Seated Knee Lift.prompt: A woman sitting tall on a dining chair lifting one knee toward her chest, side view, framed from the shoulders down, hands resting on the chair seat
Seated Knee Lift.motion: She lifts one knee, lowers it, then lifts the other, camera holds still
